title: Panasonic to localise its US data centre battery production, CEO says
title_zh: 松下首席执行官表示，将实现美国数据中心电池生产的本地化
summary: Panasonic is seeking to localise its U.S. supply chain for energy storage systems as it prepares ‌to produce battery cells at a plant in Kansas as ‌part of a shift towards supplying data centres, the Japanese group's CEO said on ​Tuesday.
summary_zh: 日本松下集团首席执行官周二表示，松下正在寻求将其美国储能系统供应链本地化，准备在堪萨斯州的一家工厂生产电池，作为向数据中心供应转变的一部分。

title: Tech stocks on pace for best 6 months since 2023 — even with much of the 'Magnificent 7' in the 'penalty box': Chart of the Day
title_zh: 科技股仍将创 2023 年以来 6 个月最佳表现——尽管“七强”中的大部分都处于“惩罚区”：每日图表
summary: Tech stocks are set to notch their strongest first half of the year since 2023, when the AI boom first drove equities higher.
summary_zh: 科技股今年上半年将创下自 2023 年以来最强劲的表现，当时人工智能热潮首次推动股市走高。

title: Chip Stocks’ Best Quarter Ever Is Ending With Some Wild Swings
title_zh: 芯片股有史以来最好的一个季度以剧烈波动结束
summary: (Bloomberg) -- Chip stocks are heading for their best quarter ever, extending an extraordinary start to the year driven by insatiable demand for artificial intelligence equipment.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——在人工智能设备永不满足的需求的推动下，芯片股正迎来有史以来最好的季度，为今年带来了非凡的开局。

title: House Passes Online Safety Bill as Senate Eyes Stricter Push
title_zh: 众议院通过在线安全法案，参议院加大力度推动
summary: (Bloomberg) -- The House on Monday passed legislation to require new online safety protections for children, a sign of growing momentum in Washington to address a widespread concern among US parents even as the measure sets up a clash with senators seeking stronger safeguards....
summary_zh: （彭博社）——众议院周一通过了一项立法，要求对儿童采取新的在线安全保护措施，这是华盛顿解决美国家长普遍担忧的势头不断增强的迹象，尽管该措施与寻求更强有力保护措施的参议员发生了冲突。

title: Retail 'FOMO' drives record SpaceX Options volume following blockbuster IPO
title_zh: 零售业“FOMO”推动 SpaceX 期权成交量创历史新高
summary: Henry Schwartz, Cboe VP of Derivatives Market Intelligence joins Yahoo Finance's Josh Lipton to discuss how SpaceX (SPCX) options volume exploded on day one, shattering Meta’s (META) previous record with 1.8 million contracts traded.
summary_zh: 芝加哥期权交易所衍生品市场情报副总裁亨利·施瓦茨 (Henry Schwartz) 与雅虎财经的乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 一起讨论了 SpaceX (SPCX) 期权交易量如何在第一天爆炸式增长，打破了 Meta (META) 之前的 180 万份合约交易记录。

title: Alphabet joins the Dow, Verizon-BT deal, Comcast plans split into 2 companies
title_zh: Alphabet 加入道指、Verizon-BT 交易，康卡斯特计划分拆为两家公司
summary: Market Domination Host Josh Lipton tracks several of the day's top trending stock tickers, including Alphabet (GOOG, GOOGL) joining the Dow Jones Industrial Average (^DJI).
summary_zh: 市场主导主持人乔什·利普顿 (Josh Lipton) 追踪当日热门热门股票行情，其中包括加入道琼斯工业平均指数 (^DJI) 的 Alphabet (GOOG、GOOGL)。

title: Why Samsung & SK Hynix are investing so much in South Korea's AI build-out
title_zh: 为什么三星和 SK 海力士在韩国的人工智能建设上投入如此多的资金
summary: Samsung (005930.KS) and SK Hynix (000660.KS) are investing $880 billion in South Korea's artificial intelligence (AI) build-out. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley outlines the details.
summary_zh: 三星 (005930.KS) 和 SK 海力士 (000660.KS) 正在投资 8800 亿美元用于韩国人工智能 (AI) 建设。雅虎财经技术编辑 Dan Howley 概述了详细信息。

title: Why investors are rotating into mid and small-cap stocks
title_zh: 投资者为何转向中小盘股
summary: Monetary Matters Network Co-Founder Jack Farley and AInvest Managing Editor Adam Shapiro join Julie Hyman on Morning Brief to discuss the market's rotation into mid-cap and small-cap stocks, highlighting which sectors are benefiting most.
summary_zh: Monetary Matters Network 联合创始人 Jack Farley 和 AInvest 执行编辑 Adam Shapiro 与 Julie Hyman 一起在 Morning Brief 中讨论了市场转向中型和小型股票的情况，并强调了哪些行业受益最大。

title: Wall Street has sky-high expectations for second quarter earnings
title_zh: 华尔街对第二季度盈利抱有极高期望
summary: Talk about high expectations for earnings season!
summary_zh: 谈论对财报季的高期望！
